invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter typically identifies the commit time and is expected to be non-null for table operations.
The hoodieRecords parameter represents the set of records to upsert and must be non-null to perform an upsert.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is required for the operation to execute in any distributed data-processing scenario.
Upsert operations usually require at least one record to process; empty record lists may be considered invalid for upsert.
The instantTime string should be non-empty as it typically represents a timestamp or version identifier.
